t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes have different colour hats and are always appear as the same pair or two colours. Particular colours take you to a light or dark forest. Different amounts of mushrooms will appear in each forest.

vb_textbox.text: It is completely random and it doesn't matter at all which one you choose. Some gnomes take you to a dark forest, some take you to a light one but there is absolutely no difference so just choose whichever ones you feel like.
